# Will an axe throwing bar make money? Monthly profit, payback and break-even fill

> Free calculator for axe throwing bars and venues. Enter thrower capacity, sessions, fill, ticket price, private events, leagues, staff, rent and the build; it shows monthly profit, margin, payback, break-even fill and the lowest ticket for your target margin and payback. Private, in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
